answer: Proof of unique satellite TV subscription with broadcaster attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a subscription the broadcaster billed across years, the karst of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A farm doing the maths finds the nadir first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The ledge is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
